items.source: Alternative to RestTestClient.ResponseSpec.expectBody(Class) that accepts information about a target type with generics.
items.translation: 作为 `RestTestClient.ResponseSpec.expectBody(Class)` 的替代方案，它接受有关泛型目标类型的信息。

items.source: Uses of RestTestClient.BodySpec in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client
Support for testing Spring MVC applications via RestTestClient with MockMvc for server request handling.
items.translation: 支持通过 `RestTestClient` 测试 Spring MVC 应用程序，并使用 `MockMvc` 处理服务器请求。

items.source: Consume and decode the response body to a single object of type <B> and then apply assertions.
items.translation: 将响应体解析并解码为单个类型为 `<B>` 的对象，然后应用断言。

items.source: Spec for expectations on the response body decoded to a single Object.
items.translation: 用于响应体解码为单个对象的期望规范。
